title_en: Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Gao Lianming — intentional homicide, robbery, and rape case

full_text_en:
Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao,

and Gao Lianming — Case of Intentional Homicide, Robbery, and Rape

Defendant: Shang Weijun (also known as Shang Weijun), male, 21 years old, native of Yancheng City, Jiangsu Province, farmer. Detained on November 9, 1995; arrested on November 10, 1995.

Defendant: Sun Jianzhong (also known as Sun Jianzhong), male, 22 years old, native of Yancheng City, Jiangsu Province, farmer. Detained on November 5, 1995; arrested on November 10, 1995.

Defendant: Sun Longbiao (also known as Sun Longbiao), male, 19 years old, native of Yancheng City, Jiangsu Province, farmer. Detained on November 5, 1995; arrested on November 10, 1995.

Defendant: Gao Lianming, male, 21 years old, native of Yancheng City, Jiangsu Province, farmer. Detained on November 5, 1995; arrested on November 10, 1995.

The case of defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Gao Lianming for intentional homicide, robbery, and rape was instituted by the Wuxi Municipal People's Procuratorate before the Wuxi Intermediate People's Court. After public trial, the Wuxi Intermediate People's Court found:

Defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Gao Lianming, after premeditation, at approximately 8:00 p.m. on September 29, 1995, carrying knives, adhesive tape, and other tools, entered the home of Yan Yongbao at No. 36 Sun Lane, Hongwuyue Village, Huangxiang Township, Wuxi Suburbs. Threatening with knives, they bound the hands and feet of Yan Yongbao (male, 46), Wei Bohua (male, 51), Sun Qingdi (female, 45), and Sun (female, 41), sealed their mouths with adhesive tape, and robbed over RMB 2,000, one gold necklace, one gold ring, and other items. Thereafter, the four defendants respectively used ropes and wires to strangle the necks, and used knives to cut and stab, causing the deaths of Yan Yongbao, Wei Bohua, and Sun Qingdi, and causing minor injury to Sun.

Defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, and Sun Longbiao, at approximately 8:00 a.m. on October 4, 1995, carrying knives, adhesive tape, and other tools, entered the home of Tian Liya (female, 21) at No. 21 Jishan Temple, Hujing Village, Yushan Town, Changshu City. Threatening with knives, they bound Tian Liya's hands and feet, sealed her mouth with adhesive tape, and robbed over RMB 1,000 and one savings card of the Agricultural Bank of China (with a deposit of RMB 1,616.34) and other items. Shang Weijun raped Tian Liya by force. Thereafter, Shang Weijun and Sun Jianzhong strangled Tian Liya to death with shoelaces.

Defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Yang Chenhai (separately prosecuted), at approximately 4:00 p.m. on October 18, 1995, carrying knives, adhesive tape, and other tools, entered the home of Dai at Room 501, Block 1, Guangming, Runzhou District, Zhenjiang City, under the pretext of looking for someone. Threatening with knives, they bound the hands and feet of Dai (male, 26) and Ren (female, 23), sealed their mouths with adhesive tape, and robbed over RMB 300, two gold rings, one pair of gold earrings, and other items.

Defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, and Sun Longbiao, at approximately 4:00 p.m. on October 29, 1995, carrying knives, adhesive tape, cloth belts, and other tools, entered the home of Zhou Qinxian (female, 32) at Room 306, Building 17, Datong Xincun, Yicheng Town, Yixing City. Threatening with knives, they bound Zhou Qinxian's hands and feet, sealed her mouth with adhesive tape, and then searched the home for valuables. At approximately 5:00 p.m., Zhou's husband Jiang Keji (30) and daughter Jiang Qianling (6) returned home. Shang Weijun and Sun Longbiao immediately approached them with knives, bound the hands and feet of Jiang Keji and Jiang Qianling, and sealed their mouths with adhesive tape. Thereafter, Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, and Sun Longbiao strangled Jiang Keji, Jiang Qianling, and Zhou Qinxian to death with nylon ropes. At that time, Qian Jinhong (male, 48) came to the Jiang home on business. After he knocked and entered, the three defendants killed Qian Jinhong by strangulation using the same methods. The three defendants together robbed over RMB 10, one Motorola 9900 mobile phone, and gold rings, gold necklaces, leather jackets, watches, cameras, suitcases, and expensive cigarettes and liquor, among other items.

Defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, and Sun Longbiao, at approximately 8:00 p.m. on October 27, 1995, carrying knives, adhesive tape, and other tools, entered the home of Zhu at Room 101, Building 28, Jiefang Xincun, Suzhou City, under the pretext of looking for someone. Threatening with knives, they bound the hands and feet of Zhu (male, 49) and Yin (female, 44), sealed their mouths with adhesive tape, and robbed over RMB 700, RMB 5,000 in Suzhou Printing and Dyeing Factory financing bonds, and gold necklaces, gold bracelets, gold rings, gold earrings, watches, airline suitcases, and other items, as well as one identity card of Zhu Yawen.

Defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, and Sun Longbiao, at approximately 9:00 p.m. on October 29, 1995, carrying knives, adhesive tape, and other tools, entered the rented residence of Chen Yinhai at No. 1 Zhaojiahan, Yunyang Town, Danyang City. Threatening with knives, they bound the hands and feet of Chen Yinhai (male, 33) and Huang Chun (male, 26), sealed their mouths with adhesive tape, and robbed over RMB 26,000. Thereafter, the three defendants killed Chen Yinhai and Huang Chun by strangulation with ropes and stabbing with knives.

Forensic examination determined: Yan Yongbao, Tian Liya, Jiang Keji, Zhou Qinxian, Jiang Qianling, and Qian Jinhong died of mechanical asphyxia; Wei Bohua and Huang Chun died of hemorrhagic shock; Sun Qingdi and Chen Yinhai died of mechanical asphyxia combined with hemorrhagic shock; Sun sustained minor injuries. After the case was solved, the public security organs recovered stolen funds of RMB 12,107.3, Suzhou Printing and Dyeing Factory financing bonds of RMB 5,000, one leather jacket, one gold necklace, one diamond ring, four watches, one Agricultural Bank of China savings card, and other items.

The above facts are confirmed by the defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Gao Lianming's confessions regarding the time, place, means, and tools of the crimes, as well as the victims' reports and written statements, witness testimony, the public security organs' crime scene inspection records, crime scene photographs, forensic examination reports, forensic evidence examination reports, and scientific technical identification reports, and the recovered stolen money and goods and the tools used in the crimes, including knives, adhesive tape, and others. The facts are clear and the evidence is reliable and sufficient to be established.

The Wuxi Intermediate People's Court held that the defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Gao Lianming intentionally deprived others of their lives, using particularly cruel means, causing particularly serious consequences, and their conduct violated Article 132 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, constituting the crime of intentional homicide, and should be severely punished. Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Gao Lianming used weapons and violence to rob others of property, with serious circumstances, and their conduct violated paragraph 2 of Article 150 of the Criminal Law, constituting the crime of robbery. Shang Weijun also used violence to rape a woman, with particularly serious circumstances, and his conduct violated paragraph 3 of Article 139 of the Criminal Law, constituting the crime of rape. Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Gao Lianming jointly committed crimes in a roaming manner, causing great social harm; pursuant to Article 22 of the Criminal Law, they engaged in joint crimes and should all be given heavier punishments. Sun Longbiao committed another crime within three years after the termination of reeducation through labor; pursuant to paragraph 1(b) of Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Handling Escapees or Recidivists of Reform-through-Labor and Reeducation-through-Labor, he should be given a heavier punishment. Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Gao Lianming each committed multiple crimes; pursuant to Article 64 of the Criminal Law, they should be punished for multiple crimes in merger. Accordingly, the Wuxi Intermediate People's Court rendered judgment on November 13, 1995:

1. Defendant Shang Weijun: guilty of intentional homicide, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; guilty of robbery, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; guilty of rape, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life. The combined sentence is death, with deprivation of political rights for life.

2. Defendant Sun Jianzhong: guilty of intentional homicide, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; guilty of robbery, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life. The combined sentence is death, with deprivation of political rights for life.

3. Defendant Sun Longbiao: guilty of intentional homicide, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; guilty of robbery, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life. The combined sentence is death, with deprivation of political rights for life.

4. Defendant Gao Lianming: guilty of intentional homicide, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; guilty of robbery, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life. The combined sentence is death, with deprivation of political rights for life.

After the first instance judgment was pronounced, defendants Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, and Sun Longbiao accepted the judgment. Defendant Gao Lianming did not accept the judgment and appealed to the Jiangsu High People's Court on the grounds that he "had no intent to kill" and "played an important role in the apprehension of Shang Weijun."

After trial, the Jiangsu High People's Court held that the facts found in the original judgment were clear and the evidence was reliable and sufficient. In the one crime in which appellant Gao Lianming participated, he, together with another defendant, strangled Sun by the neck with a rope, causing her asphyxiation; his intent to kill was manifest. After his apprehension, although Gao Lianming provided the public security organs with his estimates of where Shang Weijun had fled, these were inaccurate, and the public security organs relied on their own investigation to apprehend Shang Weijun. Gao Lianming's grounds of appeal lacked factual basis and were not sustained. The original judgment's convictions of the appellant and the defendants were accurate, the sentences were appropriate, and the trial procedures were lawful; they should be affirmed. Accordingly, the Jiangsu High People's Court ruled on November 17, 1995: the appeal was dismissed and the original judgment was affirmed.

Pursuant to the provisions of the Supreme People's Court authorizing High People's Courts to approve certain death penalty cases, the Jiangsu High People's Court, in the same ruling, approved the criminal judgments of the Wuxi Intermediate People's Court sentencing Shang Weijun, Sun Jianzhong, Sun Longbiao, and Gao Lianming to death, with deprivation of political rights for life.
